meta.title: SLATE grocery research, part four: more drinks from the same brands
meta.method: Read product by product on 2026-10-05 by searching each brand on the chain's own storefront. Price Rite (store 301, Hamden CT), The Fresh Grocer (store 197) and Smart & Final (smartandfinal.com, store 371) answered search pages at www.<chain>.com/sm/.../rsid/<id>/results?q=<brand> with real prices and UPCs; those rows are confirmed:true. SuperValu Ireland answered the same way at shop.supervalu.ie/sm/delivery/rsid/5550/results?q=<brand>; confirmed:true. Chedraui (Mexico) answered its own VTEX catalog API directly, https://www.chedraui.com.mx/api/catalog_system/pub/products/search/<brand>?map=ft, returning product name, EAN and price as JSON; confirmed:true. Tesco and Sainsbury's block automated reads of tesco.com and sainsburys.co.uk directly (HTTP 403, confirmed again this session); those rows were instead read from Trolley.co.uk, a UK grocery-price tracker, per product, with the retailer and price it names in the note: confirmed:false. Save-On-Foods (saveonfoods.com) returned HTTP 403 on every product page tried this session, as it did in part three; no rows for it are included. Giant Tiger's own product pages loaded but render price client-side in JavaScript that this session's fetch tool cannot execute, so only one Giant Tiger row is included, and its price came from a search engine's indexed copy of the page rather than a direct read: confirmed:false, said so in its note. Where a product was on promotion, the regular (non-promotional) price is recorded and the promotional price is given in the note.

fieldNotes.sizeQty: Converted to g or ml (1 oz = 28.3495 g, 1 US fl oz = 29.5735 ml), rounded to the nearest unit. For tea bags, coffee pods and multi-can packs where only a count was given, sizeQty is the count and sizeUnit is 'ct'. For multipacks of cans/bottles with a stated per-unit volume, sizeQty is the total ml across the pack.
fieldNotes.taxIncluded: false for US and CA (sales tax, where it applies to alcohol/soft drinks, is added at the register); true for GB, IE and MX, where shelf prices include VAT/IVA. Ireland's alcohol prices are also subject to minimum unit pricing.
fieldNotes.abv: Recorded only where the chain's own listing or the tracker's product page stated it as a number; every alcohol row read this session showed only the product name, size and price without a stated ABV, so abv is null throughout this file. None was looked up from an outside source or estimated.
fieldNotes.brand: Set to the specific trademark on the pack, not the parent company: Coca-Cola, Diet Coke, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Sprite and Fanta are recorded separately even though one company makes all five; likewise Pepsi and Pepsi Zero Sugar under PepsiCo, and Dr Pepper, Snapple and Canada Dry under Keurig Dr Pepper, and Corona and Modelo under Grupo Modelo.

dropped: Folgers was searched at Price Rite (no results for the term at all) and at The Fresh Grocer; one Fresh Grocer Folgers ground-coffee size (9.6 oz / 272 g, Classic Roast) was dropped because it is the same brand, roast and converted size as 'Folgers Classic Roast Ground Coffee, Medium Roast, 272 g' already recorded in research-groceries2.json, leaving Folgers at 3 products rather than 5+ this pass.

Starbucks 'Ground Medium Roast Breakfast Blend Coffee, 12 oz' at Smart & Final was dropped as a near-duplicate of 'Starbucks Breakfast Blend Medium Roast Ground Coffee, 12 oz' already recorded in research-groceries3.json; House Blend 12 oz was kept in its place since that size/variety was not previously recorded.

Corona 'Extra Beer, 12 pack, 12 fl oz' at Smart & Final was dropped: its UPC (00080660956152) is the identical SKU already recorded as 'Corona Extra Imported Beer, 12-pack, 12 fl oz bottles' in research-groceries3.json (at a different chain, Price Rite).

Snapple 'Lemon Tea, 64 fl oz' at Price Rite was dropped as an exact name-and-size duplicate of the row already recorded in research-groceries3.json; Peach Tea and Kiwi Strawberry at the same size were kept since only Lemon Tea had been recorded before.
Save-On-Foods (saveonfoods.com) returned HTTP 403 on every product URL tried (search pages and individual product pages), as in part three; no Save-On-Foods rows could be added.

Giant Tiger's product pages (gianttiger.com) loaded their HTML shell but the displayed price is injected by client-side JavaScript this session's fetch tool does not execute, so item numbers and names were readable but prices were not, for Coca-Cola 2 L, Coca-Cola 6-pack 222 ml, Diet Coke 6-pack 222 ml and Coke Zero 6-pack 222 ml; those four were dropped rather than guessed. One Giant Tiger row, Budweiser Zero 6-pack 355 ml, is included anyway with its price taken from a search engine's indexed copy of the same page, marked confirmed:false.
Tesco and Sainsbury's direct storefronts (tesco.com, sainsburys.co.uk) returned HTTP 403 on every URL tried; all GB rows in this file come from Trolley.co.uk instead, marked confirmed:false.
corrections: 2026-10-05, on review: 30 products filed under smartandfinal moved to Smart & Final's chain id, smartfinal.
